checklists.title: Emergency Kit
checklists.description: Pack these items so you can leave or stay put for several days.

items.text: Drinking water (about 3 litres per person per day for 3 days)
Ready-to-eat emergency food for 3 days
First-aid kit
Regular medicines and prescriptions (at least 7 days)
Masks
Sanitation and hygiene items
Torch
Spare batteries
Charged power bank and charging cable
Whistle
Basic tools (multi-tool, tape, rope)
Copies of important documents in a waterproof bag
Some cash in small notes

checklists.title: Home preparedness
checklists.description: Make your home safer before a disaster.

items.text: Know two exit routes from every room and keep them clear.
Learn how to switch off electricity, gas and water at the main.
Secure heavy furniture, shelves and water heaters.
Keep a fire extinguisher where you can reach it and check it is in date.
Store your emergency kit where everyone can find it.
Note which floor and room are safest for each type of disaster.

checklists.title: Before evacuation
checklists.description: Run through this when told to leave.

items.text: Charge phones and power banks.
Pack the emergency kit and essential medicines.
Take documents, cash and keys.
Switch off electricity, gas and water if it is safe to do so.
Lock the home and tell a neighbour or contact where you are going.
Follow the official route to the shelter. Do not take shortcuts through flood water.
Take pets and anyone who needs help with mobility.

checklists.title: Family safety
checklists.description: Make sure everyone knows what to do.

items.text: Agree on a family meeting point near home and one outside your area.
Make sure every adult knows the emergency plan.
Teach children their full name and a parent's phone number.
Note any medical conditions and medicines for each family member.
Plan for elderly relatives and family members with disabilities.
Practise your evacuation route together.

checklists.title: Emergency communication
checklists.description: Stay reachable when networks are down.

items.text: Save emergency contacts in SETU and on paper.
Agree on one out-of-area contact everyone will message.
Keep phones charged and a power bank ready.
Turn on Bluetooth and location permission so SETU can relay emergencies.
Know how to trigger SETU SOS quickly.
Keep a battery-powered radio for official updates.
